Mohammed Kabir is the Chief Executive Officer of Corvus Robotics. He co-founded the company with Jackie Wu in 2017 and built its first-generation drone in his MIT dorm room. He led technology and product as Chief Technology Officer before being named CEO in August 2026. He has been building with cameras, robotics, and drones since he was fourteen, and he enjoys photography, snowboarding, and cars.

Michael McSpedon is the CRO of Corvus Robotics. A 3x CRO and successful sales leader in the inventory visibility and logistics space, Mike has previously taken companies to $100M+ revenue. His prior experience includes leading sales at Overhaul, project44, and Trustwell.

Andrew Burer leads marketing at Corvus Robotics. He previously spent three years leading marketing for the Americas at Geek+, one of the world's largest warehouse robotics companies (successful IPO). He's a San Diego sports guy and former on-air sports producer at FOX 5.

Alibaba DAMO Academyが、ロボット制御用の大規模基盤モデル「RynnBrain」をオープンソースとして公開。30Bパラメータ規模のMoE（Mixture of Experts）アーキテクチャを採用し、GoogleのGemini Robotics-ER 1.5やNVIDIAのCosmos-Reason2を用いたベンチマークで最先端性能を記録したと主張。時空間メモリ機能により、長期タスクや複雑環境での経路計画が可能。中国発の高性能ロボットAIとして、欧米勢に対抗する技術力を示した。Qwen3-VLをベースに2,000万ペア以上のロボティクスデータでファインチューニングされ、Hugging FaceとGitHubで公開されている。
